dct_description_sm: This study is one component of Nunatsiavut Nuluak (ArcticNet 3.7), a project conducting a baseline inventory and comparative assessment of four Labrador fiord marine ecosystems. The objective of this study is to provide a baseline description of the production, biomass, abundance and taxonomic composition of phytoplankton in four Labrador fiords and to better understand the latitudinal and seasonal dynamics of phytoplankton communities.
dct_title_s: Production, biomass, abundance, taxonomic composition and grazing rates of phytoplankton in the Labrador Fiords in summer 2013
